add.title: Add a node
add.description: Run one command on the machine. The code in it is your approval: nodes that use it join your account without another click.

markStopped.title: Mark as stopped?
markStopped.description: wsmp couldn't confirm that this process stopped. Marking it stopped tells wsmp to stop waiting for it; nothing is run on the node to do it. Its port, memory and GPUs stay reserved until wsmp confirms the process is gone or the instance starts again (wsmp restarts an instance that should keep running). Do this only if you've checked on the node that the process is gone.
markStopped.notePlaceholder: What you checked on the node
markStopped.help: wsmp asked the node to stop this process but couldn't confirm it is gone, so its port, memory and GPUs stay reserved. While the node is online, wsmp checks again every 5 minutes. If you've checked on the node that the process is gone, use Mark as stopped.

node.title: Add a node
node.description: A node is a machine that runs models for you: a GPU server, a workstation or a laptop.
node.intro: One command installs wsmp and logs the machine in with a code that works once, for an hour. The code is your approval.
node.moreOptions: Several machines at once, labels or temporary nodes:

runtime.title: Your model servers
runtime.description: A runtime is a model server wsmp can call: one it starts when needed, or one that is always running.
runtime.presetHint: vLLM, SGLang or llama.cpp, started on one of your nodes when a pool needs it.
runtime.runningHint: If vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama or another OpenAI-compatible server already runs on a node, add it as an always-on runtime: in New runtime choose Detected server and enter its address on the node. wsmp sends requests to it and never starts or stops it.
runtime.noDetection: wsmp does not find running servers by itself yet, so add them this way.

pool.title: Create a pool
pool.description: A pool is what clients call, by its callable ID (owner/pool). Start with one served model and add more later.
pool.fromModel: Served models not in a pool yet
pool.noModels: No served models yet. Add a model server in the previous step: startable runtimes list their models once defined, always-on ones once the node reports them.
pool.allPooled: Every served model is in a pool.
pool.loadFailed: Your runtimes or pools could not be loaded.

agent.title: Connect an agent
agent.description: Agents such as coding assistants set up and run models for you through MCP.
agent.oauthHint: Add the MCP URL to an agent that supports OAuth. It opens this site, you sign in and choose Read-only or Full, and it is connected. Nothing to copy.
agent.tokenHint: For agents without OAuth: a token you paste into the agent's configuration. Read-only only reads; Full may also configure, start and stop.
agent.promptNoNode: Show me my nodes and what they can run.

apiKey.title: Create an API key
apiKey.description: Apps and SDKs call your pools with an API key at the OpenAI-compatible base URL below.

test.loadFailed: Couldn't load what you can test.
test.emptyHint: Start a runtime on one of your nodes, or create a pool. Its served models and callable IDs show up here.

errors.empty: The model answered with no text.

target.label: Target
target.notServing: Nothing serves this target right now; a request may wait for it or fail.
target.directHint: A direct test goes straight to this served model. Only you can test it, and only here or with model_test; API keys call pools.
target.missing: {{target}} isn't something you can test. Pick a target below.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Streams the answer, with the model's reasoning when it shares it.

embeddings.title: Embeddings
embeddings.description: Embeds each line and summarizes the vectors.

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.description: Transcribes an audio file, or your microphone live where the target supports it.

reasoning.label: Reasoning
reasoning.help: Reasoning levels depend on the model; Default sends none and lets the model decide.

chat.systemPlaceholder: Optional instructions sent with every turn

live.title: Live transcription
live.description: Speak into your microphone and watch this target transcribe it with the same live session API clients use (/v1/realtime). It runs as you and counts as Test usage.

status.live: Listening. Press End turn when you finish speaking.

live.empty: Transcripts appear here after each turn.
live.privacy: Audio and transcripts are not stored or logged.

mic.failed: The microphone could not be started.
mic.unsupported: This browser cannot capture microphone audio for live transcription.
